resources.string: Give the app the access it needs to stay connected to your computer. You can change any of this later in Android settings.
Review the permissions the app needs
Keeps the connection running in the background, and shows pairing requests and incoming files.
Find and talk to your computer on the same Wi-Fi.
Stops Android from putting the app to sleep. On Samsung phones this sets battery usage to Unrestricted.
Show your phone\'s notifications on your computer.
Android keeps a \"Connected to\" notification while the app runs. Turn it off here; the connection keeps working.
Let your computer turn Do Not Disturb on and off on this phone.
Read and send text messages from your computer.
See calls on your computer, and decline them from there.
Show names instead of numbers for calls and messages on your computer.
Android restricts some settings for apps installed from a file. Open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, then \"Allow restricted settings\", and try again.
